title: Waves composer focus: next waves only, inputs inline under the ticked item

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S31 (2026-10-25, owner: 'this screen is busy and ugly'). The Waves view lists all 22 suggested waves of the ork roadmap, v1.1 included; ticking S78 scrolls to the bottom, where the launch inputs sit below Unplaced, 36 lines from the item, which is scrolled out of view; every row carries a '(shares: ID path)' reason that runs off the right edge; both input fields show a cursor block, so the active field is unclear. Builds on S107 (Waves as a table), moved into v1 with this slice.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/waves.go`: show the first waves only (proposed: the first 3, or the ones holding the next `slicer next --batch` items), with "N more waves" and a key to show all; the launch inputs render directly under the ticked item and keep it in view; one cursor, on the active field.
- `internal/tui/view.go`: keep the ticked item visible when inputs open.
- `testdata/golden/waves-*.txt` and `docs/dashboard.md:404-440` (Waves).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestWavesShowsFirstWavesOnly; TestTickedItemStaysInViewWithInputs (inputs on the lines under the item); TestOnlyActiveInputShowsCursor; goldens at 80x24 and 120x40.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Pair with S107 (shares as a dim column, wave header rules, Lineup column only after ticking); run them in one wave or back to back so goldens are rebuilt once. UI slice: UI pass (r14). Proposed numbers (first 3 waves) are marked proposed until the owner confirms at preflight.

Also from S31 (second screenshot, 2026-10-25): a ticked row shows the whole fallback chain with arrows on every role (implementer: codex ... -> claude haiku xhigh -> claude sonnet medium), which crowds the title down to 'recoverRuns ...'; show the primary row per role and a dim '+2 fallbacks' (full chain on e). The reviewer and gate chains repeat the same row (fixed in S117). After ticking, nothing says the item is not launched yet; the owner read the ticked lineup as started. Show a status line such as '1 ticked, not launched: l launches' until launch, and a 'launched S78 as RUN' notice after.

After launch (S31, 2026-10-25): the composer shows only 'ork wave start ork S78: done' (CLI wording, no run id), unticks S78 and leaves it in the list as if nothing happened. Show 'launched S78 as ork-...; enter opens it in Overview', mark launched items as running in the list (or drop them), and offer a jump to the run.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/tui; go test ./internal/tui -update then review goldens; slicer check; adj lint.
